harness: fixed Merc media_transcode contract: ffmpeg + ffprobe, env-clear, protocol_whitelist=file,pipe, libx264 threads=1, bitexact, one 320x180 input
transport: in-process agent MediaTranscodeRunner contract; local FFmpeg process
model_note: Merc-owned fixed contract; codec and binary notices remain separately governed

input_fixture.work_unit_definition: media_work_units = input_bytes / 4; settlement keeps the exact fractional value and the quote/submit input commitment

physical_throughput.basis: 430.5 media_work_units divided by the slowest and fastest of 20 real FFmpeg subprocess wall times; the slowest rate is the only admission bound

byte_determinism.output_sha256: measured separately by the runner's output readback; all 20 outputs were byte-identical

failure_bounds.teardown: kill_on_drop plus private scratch directory cleanup
